scope: benchmark-only source enrollment; no TandemX production-code change

header_probe.method: decompress the complete leading BGZF block from the verified 1 MiB range probe
header_probe.interpretation: the internal BAM sample identifier is not ZH13 and does not by itself close cultivar identity

direct_transport.range_probe: CRR705248 bytes=0-1048575 returned HTTP 206 and exact Content-Range on 2026-09-11
direct_transport.range_probe_interpretation: transport supports byte ranges, but a BAM byte range without a published index is not a valid read/spot extractor

material_linkage.assembly_to_ont: same BioSample SAMC1127443; CRR705247 is ONT, not HiFi
material_linkage.assembly_to_hifi: same official BioProject PRJCA015269 and same ZH13 genome-assembly study, but HiFi is BioSample SAMC1127444 while assembly is SAMC1127443
material_linkage.use_boundary: eligible only as a positive/control cohort after the source-acquisition gate; do not describe it as an independently donor-matched HiFi validation

fixed_30x_plan.freeze_rule_after_complete_source_qc: Stream both complete BAM files in the listed order, calculate total biological read bases B, then use source-base offsets floor(i*(B-A)/2) through offset+A for i=0,1,2 and A=10072376690. Preserve complete read records, report the resulting read-boundary overshoot, exact bases, IDs and SHA256 for each FASTQ partition.
required_gates_before_extraction: both downloaded BAM files equal their HEAD content lengths
both files pass BAM EOF/record parsing with an explicitly recorded reader version
self-computed SHA256 retained because no repository checksum is published
1000-read end-to-end converter gate on complete BAM input
no active V14167 block_01 or YSD56 sampling process is materially slowed
fixed_30x_plan.current_gate_state: blocked_before_source_acquisition: VDB spot-range converter applies to SRA VDB tab streams, not these NGDC BAM endpoints; no BAM reader/index is currently available and a byte-range fragment is not valid evidence of read extraction

analysis_boundary: No result may be called 30x, HiFi-based, donor-matched, or TandemX-only until every source and partition gate completes and all three read-level discovery tools finish.
